prompt: The illustration presents a looping vertical pathway at its center, where a luminous goal sphere enters at the top and is transformed by a single autonomous figure—rendered as a walking circuit-board silhouette—into a cascading sequence of discrete tasks: a scroll of mathematical proof, a screen of diagnostic tests, and a returning arrow of revised strategy, all without any human hand hovering nearby to type individual commands. To the left, a static chatbot icon sits enclosed in a simple isolated bubble, showing only one prompt entering and one answer leaving, visually emphasizing its limitation to single-turn exchange. To the right, the composition opens into a vast dark field populated by roughly ten thousand smaller duplicates of the central circuit figure, all active simultaneously and connected by a dense mesh of bright message lines that fork toward countless dead-end nodes before converging on a shared, illuminated equation suggestive of the Navier-Stokes problem, making visible how a swarm of agents shares intermediate results in parallel exploration. Together the three zones contrast the closed reply loop of a chatbot with the iterative, self-directed, massively parallel agency of true AI systems.
